claim: A RELATIVE command path in a skill frontmatter hook (command: ./x.py) did not fire in testing; it resolves against the hook process cwd, not the skill directory, and ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR} is NOT substituted in hook commands
method: A skill was authored with a frontmatter hooks: block whose command used a relative path to a script beside SKILL.md. The hook never executed in live sessions. The same handler wired through settings.json with an absolute path fired correctly.
reproduction: Author a skill with frontmatter hooks using command: ./probe.py where probe.py writes a marker file. Invoke the skill; check the marker is absent. Move the same hook into settings.json with an absolute quoted path; check the marker appears.
caveat: Negative result on one build; re-test after upgrades before relying on it.
